clue.text: Part, we hear, by counter is protection for car?

indicators.note: we hear tells us the word for part is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: a part is a role an actor plays
a bar is a counter where drinks are served

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about which component, sitting next to a counter, keeps a car safe.
explanation.walkthrough: ROLE sounds like ROLL. A ROLLBAR is the strong hoop that protects people in a car that turns over.
explanation.definitionFit: This reinforcing hoop is a safety device guarding a vehicle's occupants if it overturns.

clue.text: Criminal activity shown by a male in posh car with support

indicators.note: with means the support follows on
in means these letters sit inside the posh car

parts.note: RR stands for a Rolls-Royce
aid means support or help

explanation.surface: A man in a luxury car is accused of a crime with help.
explanation.walkthrough: A RAM-RAID is a British term for a burglary where a vehicle is driven into a shop front.
explanation.definitionFit: This smash-and-grab theft using a vehicle is a type of crime.

clue.text: Illness troubled girl around university

indicators.note: around means the mixed letters go round the university letter
troubled means disturbed, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A girl is ill and troubled around her university.
explanation.walkthrough: LURGI (also lurgy) is British slang for an unspecified illness, as in 'the dreaded lurgy'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is jocular slang for some vague bug or ailment.

clue.text: Short song about Irish woman, one on stage?

indicators.note: about means the cut song goes around the other piece
short means the word is cut, losing its last letter

parts.note: a ballad is a song
Erin is a poetic name for Ireland and a girl's name

explanation.surface: A brief song about an Irish woman, perhaps a performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A ballet dancer performs on stage, so she is one who appears there.

clue.text: One coming out of retirement for flight in part

definitions.meaning: someone getting up out of bed, retirement meaning going to bed
the vertical part of each step in a flight of stairs

explanation.definitionFit: An early riser gets out of bed, and a riser is the upright face of a stair.

clue.text: Key friend retaining four books

indicators.note: retaining means the word for friend holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: pal is a friend
IV is four in Roman numerals
OT is the Old Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A key friend holds on to four books.
explanation.definitionFit: Key as an adjective means crucial, central to everything else.

clue.text: Cheese placed around cooked roast close to grill

indicators.note: around means the word for placed goes round the other pieces

parts.note: put means placed

indicators.note: cooked means altered, so the letters are rearranged
close to means the end letter of the word grill

explanation.surface: Cheese is set around a roast near the grill.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Salut is a mild French cheese.

clue.text: Very ace sink promoted in flat

parts.note: A is short for ace in cards

indicators.note: promoted means raised up, so in a down clue the word reads upwards

parts.note: to dip is to sink

explanation.surface: A very good sink installed in a flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Vapid means dull and lifeless, flat in character.

clue.text: Sailor, six-footer, with tricky haul ignoring hot venomous type

parts.note: a tar is a sailor
an ant is an insect with six feet

indicators.note: tricky means awkward, so the letters are rearranged
ignoring means the hot letter is left out

explanation.surface: A sailor and an insect make a difficult catch, leaving out the heat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignoring' removes H from HAUL, and 'tricky' shuffles the remaining AUL into ULA.
explanation.definitionFit: The tarantula is a large spider with a venomous bite.

clue.text: Battalion (Essex) conscripting one with pride

indicators.note: conscripting means enlisting, so the words hold the answer within them

explanation.surface: An Essex battalion enlists a proud recruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of lions is a pride, so a lioness is one of its members.

clue.text: Mean type occupied by exam, sanctimonious sort

indicators.note: occupied by means the mean type has the exam sitting inside it

parts.note: a miser is a stingy, mean person
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A stingy person sitting an exam turns out to be self-righteous.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who preaches about right and wrong is a sanctimonious type.

clue.text: City left with nothing

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A city abandoned and left with nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: PORTO is the Portuguese city also called Oporto.
explanation.definitionFit: Porto is a major city in northern Portugal, known for its wine.

clue.text: Private comment is part of bias I detected

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A remark made under the breath reveals some prejudice someone noticed.
explanation.definitionFit: An aside is a remark made privately or quietly, as an actor speaks to the audience.

clue.text: Abode about to get sinkage (subscription cancelled)

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: cancelled means the subscription is struck out of the longer word

parts.note: subsidence is the gradual sinking of ground

explanation.surface: A house is about to suffer ground sinking, and a subscription has been cancelled.
explanation.definitionFit: A residence is a home, the place where someone lives.

clue.text: Deft clue I misjudged? It's misleading

indicators.note: misjudged suggests getting things wrong, so the letters are put in a different order

explanation.surface: A setter admits a clever clue was misjudged because it misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deceitful leads people astray, so it is misleading.

clue.text: Nine court assembled for ancient officer

indicators.note: assembled means put together, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A court of nine meets for an old officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A centurion commanded a hundred men in the Roman army.

clue.text: Fine staple food with a lot of advantage included in dish

parts.note: F is short for fine on pencils

indicators.note: included in means the trimmed piece goes inside the staple food

parts.note: rice is a staple food

indicators.note: a lot of means most of the word, last letter dropped

parts.note: an asset is an advantage

explanation.surface: A fine basic food with plenty of benefit goes into a dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A fricassee is a stew of meat in a white sauce, a dish.

clue.text: Suit for social venues

definitions.meaning: one of the four suits in a pack of cards
places where members meet and socialise, or nightspots

explanation.definitionFit: Clubs are a card suit and also places where people gather to socialise.

clue.text: Condemn credit given by one located in corrupt cities

indicators.note: located in means the one is placed inside the other letters
corrupt means spoiled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: I is one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Someone condemns how credit is handed out in crooked cities.
explanation.definitionFit: To criticise is to find fault with, to condemn.

clue.text: Home around North trailed by a creature

indicators.note: trailed by means the a comes after the rest
around means the home goes round the compass point

parts.note: a pad is slang for a home or flat

explanation.surface: Someone's flat near the north, followed by a creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The panda is a bear-like animal, so it is a creature.

clue.text: Temporary repair in plot of land on high?

parts.note: a patch is a small plot of land
up means high

explanation.surface: A hasty fix on an elevated piece of land.
explanation.definitionFit: A patch-up is a quick makeshift mend.

clue.text: Fashionable gallery incorporating largely well-funded complex

parts.note: in means fashionable, as in the in thing

indicators.note: incorporating means the gallery takes another piece into itself

parts.note: the Tate is a famous London art gallery

indicators.note: largely means most of the word, its last letter dropped

parts.note: rich means wealthy or well-funded

explanation.surface: A trendy gallery takes on a well-funded and complicated project.
explanation.walkthrough: 'largely' drops the final letter of the word for well-funded; the Tate is a famous London art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: Intricate and complex both describe something with many interlocking parts.

clue.text: Day before break for summit

parts.note: the eve is the day before an event
a rest is a break

explanation.surface: Resting the day before an attempt on the summit.
explanation.definitionFit: Everest is the highest mountain summit in the world.

clue.text: Digital sketch?

parts.note: a quick little sketch, read also as something on a finger, digital meaning of the digits

explanation.definitionFit: A rough small drawing is called a thumbnail, and the thumb is a digit with a nail.

clue.text: Stick in message from cricket captain refusing to declare?

definitions.meaning: a rod or staff, such as a conductor's or relay runner's

definitions.text: message from cricket captain refusing to declare?
definitions.meaning: a captain who will not end the innings tells batsmen to keep batting

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, to declare is to end your innings early; a captain who refuses would say 'bat on'.
explanation.definitionFit: A baton is a short stick, and the phrase split in two is an instruction to continue batting.

clue.text: Line followed by legendary vessel in a slow movement

parts.note: the Argo was Jason's ship in Greek myth

explanation.surface: A line followed by a mythical ship, moving slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: Largo is a musical tempo marking, and a piece in that tempo.

clue.text: Combined number in queue lacking leader

indicators.note: in means the number goes inside the shortened queue
lacking leader means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a line is a queue

explanation.surface: A number in a queue loses its place at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things rolled together into a single item are combined.

clue.text: Fantastic section in bout remembered

indicators.note: section in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A great part of a fight that stayed in the memory.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre means bizarre or outlandish, fantastic in the sense of strange.

clue.text: Lift from compere entertaining one

indicators.note: entertaining means holding a guest, so the compere contains the other piece

parts.note: a host is a compere who presents a show
I is one in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A lift given by a presenter who entertains someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To hoist is to raise up or lift something.

clue.text: Some tableware? I've rest ordered with note

indicators.note: ordered means arranged afresh, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: te is a note in the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone says they have put the remaining dishes in order, with a note.
explanation.definitionFit: A serviette is a table napkin, part of what is laid at a table.

clue.text: Writer, one accepting start of nasty punishment

parts.note: a pen is something that writes

indicators.note: accepting means the one takes in the next piece

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards

indicators.note: start of means take the first letter of the word nasty

explanation.surface: A writer accepts the beginning of an unpleasant punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Penance is self-punishment undertaken to atone for wrongdoing.

clue.text: English rambler's second to enter exposed gorge

indicators.note: to enter means these pieces go inside the word for exposed

parts.note: overt means open, exposed to view

indicators.note: second here means the second letter of the word rambler is taken

explanation.surface: An English hiker goes into an open gorge.
explanation.definitionFit: To gorge oneself is to stuff oneself, eating too much.
